name: Karolina's Confession
source:
A wholesome romance (with a tinge of angst) between two young, noble nuns within a women's monastery in the early Middle Ages, who must hide their love from the strictly conservative high priest.

[From [url=https://quissumi.itch.io/karolinas-confession]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
中世纪早期，一座女子修道院里，两位年轻高贵的修女之间发生了一段健康的浪漫故事（带着一丝焦虑），她们必须向严格保守的大祭司隐瞒她们的爱情。

[来自[url=https://quissumi.itch.io/karolinas-confession]itch.io[/url]]
